data.body: Reproduced deterministically (3/3): loading the module under a clock 2 h in the past and running the cases on the real clock makes the nbf case accept the token. Fix: each case is a function of now, evaluated in the test body, plus a regression test that runs a separate module copy collected 2 h early (fails on the old code, passes now). Tree scan found no other import-time clock values. Module 26/26 pass 3 runs plus xdist; make lint and make typecheck pass; 798 tree-scan policy tests pass. Pushed as Gerrit change 3292.
